title: A Reconstructed-Laplacian Method for the Surface Biharmonic Equation on Parametric Meshes
summary: We develop and analyze a continuous/discontinuous Galerkin (CDG) method based on reconstructed surface Laplacians for the biharmonic equation on a smooth closed surface. Continuous mapped finite elements of degree $k\ge2$ are used on fitted parametric meshes of degree $r\ge1$, while a discontinuous degree-$(k-2)$ lifting corrects the broken Laplace-Beltrami operator for two-sided conormal-flux jumps.
